research.facts:
2028 EE100 Top-5 Reveal
**Sources consulted:**
- extrainningsoftball.com (EE100 rankings schedule)
- Previous pipeline notes (Oct 23-26)
**Verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Extra Inning Softball scheduled the Extra Elite 100 Class of 2028 Top-5 reveal for Oct. 27 (per rankings schedule page)
- Rankings covered #100-6 between Oct. 13-26, a two-week countdown
- Class of 2028 received 1,200+ nominations — largest in EE100 history
- Texas has Landers at No. 1 overall, Florida has Holden at No. 2, OU has Schlader at No. 3 (from previous research, positions 3-100 published)
- A separate Fastpitch Fan Pick Top 5 also publishes in this window
- Contact window for Class of 2028 (juniors) closed Oct. 24-25; next contact window not until spring 2027
**Verified facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Top-5 names not yet published at time of research (10AM ET); rankings may drop mid-morning to afternoon
- Schedule may show Oct. 27 or Oct. 28 for final reveal (sources conflict slightly); Oct. 27 consistent with prior pipeline notes
